hero.text: Welcome! We're a group of creators making original Minecraft events, videos and community projects together, and we'd love to have you along.

status.pageText: Here's how everything at Mirage is running right now, from the website to the server and Discord.

disclaimer.title: Content Disclaimer
paragraphs: Our actors and POV creators are not highly trained professionals, and they may make errors or mistakes within their videos, performances, gameplay or actions.
Please do not treat them with disrespect. Patience and constructive feedback help everyone improve and keep Mirage a positive creative space.
Mirage content is created for entertainment and storytelling. Some scenes, characters and events may be fictional or performed specifically for a production.

eula.title: End User License Agreement
eula.text: Read the complete Mirage agreement in the hosted document.

updates.title: What's New
updates.text: The latest Mirage launches, changes and production updates, all in one place.

items.title: Script Writer Applications Opened
items.body: Mirage opened recruitment for Script Writers to help develop event stories, scenes and production material.

items.title: Mirage Events Website Launched
items.body: The official Mirage website went live with creator information, videos, applications and project information.

items.title: New Production Team Structure Introduced
items.body: Mirage introduced a clearer production structure for creators, actors, trusted members, builders and staff.

forms.title: Join the Mirage Team
forms.text: Pick a role, tell us about yourself and send it in. Give accurate details so the team can review your application properly.
forms.successText: Thanks for applying to Mirage. The team will review it and get in touch on Discord or by email.

support.title: How can we help?
support.text: For assistance with Mirage, submit a ticket through our official support portal. Our team will review your enquiry and respond through the support system.
support.cardText: Use the portal to submit a support ticket, report an issue, or request assistance. Please include a clear description of your enquiry and any relevant details.
support.securityNote: Security reminder: Never share your password, verification codes, API keys, or account recovery details. Mirage staff will never ask for your password.

legal.title: Legal & Policies
legal.text: This page contains the rules, policies and agreements that apply to Mirage Productions, its Minecraft server, events, community spaces and recruitment processes. Please read the documents relevant to your use of Mirage.
